name: Tado-Assistant
description: Tado Assistant: Your User-Friendly, Free Tado Auto-Assist Alternative

variables.name: Number of Accounts
variables.description: Number of Tado accounts you wish to manage. This should be set to the total number of accounts.

variables.name: Account 1 - Username
variables.description: Your Tado account username for the nth account.

variables.name: Account 1 - Password
variables.description: Your Tado account password for the nth account.

variables.name: Account 1 - Checking Interval
variables.description: Frequency (in seconds) for home state checks for the nth account. Default is every 15 seconds.

variables.name: Account 1 - Logging
variables.description: Toggle logging for the nth account. Values: true or false. Default is false.

variables.name: Account 1 - Max Open Window Duration
variables.description: Define the maximum duration (in seconds) for the 'Open Window' detection feature to be active for the nth account. Leave this field empty to use the default duration set in the Tado app.
